evidence_quote:
In this paper a method for automated 
classification of load profiles of electric drives is 
discussed on the example of the mentioned spindle load 
profiles.

the specific energy consumption, 
energy performance indicators and operation time of 
each individual part can be calculated.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper presents a signal-processing / pattern-recognition method (Hidden Markov Models, Cross-Correlation, Wavelet and Fourier transforms) for classifying/segmenting load profiles of electric drives on a CNC lathe example. Energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally as a prospective downstream calculation ('can be calculated'); no EnPI or energy-baseline (EnB) measurement model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline construction; only cross-correlation coefficients are actually reported). Ineligible per v2.3 (incidental EnPI mention, no model characterised).

paper_type.evidence_quote:
In this paper methods for pattern 
recognition in load profiles of electric drives are 
presented on the example of a multiaxial lathe.

stage1.notes: BORDERLINE eligibility (human review): a lenient v2.3 reading could treat HMM-segmentation-enabled per-part specific energy consumption as a characterised EnPI construction approach, but no EnPI value is computed (only cross-correlation coefficients reported). paper_type borderline: methodological method-paper vs single applied case (empirical lathe demo). Domain = discrete manufacturing (CNC lathe), out of L3B scope regardless.
